dedupRules.containerVsWork: NPNF volumes, anthology volumes and source bundles are Edition/Container unless they are themselves authored Works.
dedupRules.segmentVsWork: letters, homilies, chapters and demonstrations remain segments/components when the historical identity is a collection/corpus.
dedupRules.crossLanguage: title-language differences do not create new Works when authorship/content identity matches.
dedupRules.crossSource: PRDL bibliographic record + CCEL readable text + original-language corpus can jointly describe one Work without copying all data into one source.

visualAdmission.rule: A cover/title-page belongs to a concrete Edition/source witness and is projected onto the canonical Work with provenance.

translationAdmission.eligibleNowWhen: chosen readable witness is public domain/open and complete enough for the selected scope
translationAdmission.partial: partial witnesses may support excerpt/segment translation but must not claim whole-work availability
translationAdmission.context: Doré Context may combine author/work terminology and adjacent segments; original/older-language witness remains attachable without blocking English-first reading

scaleConsequence: PRDL currently reports over 110k titles and nearly 150k volumes; those numbers remain source scale, not Dawn Library book count. Canonical thinning is intentionally reductive.
